title: Object Storage Container Made Public
content: A cloud storage container ACL was updated so anonymous users can read objects. The change was made by a user who rarely administers storage, and object downloads increase after the change.

expected.threat_summary: A cloud storage container is made publicly readable and may expose data.
key_behaviors: storage ACL allows anonymous or public read access
object access or download activity follows
mitre_mapping: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
hunt_checklist: Review cloud audit logs for bucket/container/object ACL or policy changes.
Confirm whether public principals such as allUsers, anonymous, or Everyone were granted access.
Review object access/download activity after the exposure.
expected.correlation_logic: Correlate storage policy change by actor, bucket/container/object, public principal, source IP, and follow-on downloads.
expected.escalation_condition: Escalate when sensitive storage is made public without approval.
expected.analyst_notes: Hand-authored external gold standard case for accuracy/generalization evaluation.
